europe_now.title: Ukraine conflict escalates with deadly Russian strikes on civilian targets
europe_now.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky has requested additional Patriot interceptors amid a surge in civilian casualties in Ukraine, which have reached the highest level since 2022. The appeal highlights the escalating impact of Russian strikes on civilian populations.

sources.headline: Ukraine: Zelensky asks for more Patriot interceptors as civilian deaths hit highest level since 2022

europe_now.title: Eastern Mediterranean energy dynamics
europe_now.summary: A new energy war is unfolding in the Eastern Mediterranean, with Egypt and Turkey positioned to gain strategic advantages. The conflict centers on control of energy resources and shipping routes in the region.

sources.headline: The new energy war in the Eastern Mediterranean (and why Egypt and Turkey stand to gain)
